# @loom/editor

> Shared, accessible rich-text editing components for React apps. Persist editor values as Lexical JSON.

## Start here
- [Package exports](./package.json)
- [Core public API](./src/index.ts)
- [React bindings](./src/react.tsx)
- [Client editor and toolbar](./src/client.tsx)
- [Editor JSON types](./src/types.ts)
- [Tests](./tests/)

## Rules for agents
- Store and exchange `EditorJSON`; this package does not promise HTML serialization.
- Prefer direct package subpath imports. Import the client entry only from client-side React code.
- Keep toolbar controls accessible and composable; do not add application-specific menus or business rules here.
- Lexical is the editor engine. Do not replace it with a second document model.
